definition_used: An investigation by any third party that is not the United States Office of Research Integrity (ORI).
caution: The definition only specifies the source of investigation (third party, not ORI) without indicating what is being investigated or the nature of the problem. It is a procedural metadata signal about investigation location, not a substantive manuscript integrity category. No manuscript-facing category is directly supported without additional context.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes an investigation by a non-ORI third party, which is a process signal (third_party_investigation) with actor context (third_party). It does not inherently indicate a problem with research content, authorship, editorial processes, or post-publication oversight; it merely notes that an investigation occurred. Therefore, no manuscript category is assigned.
